desc:
😱 Can YOU survive the scariest Roblox horror elevator game?
Every floor is a new nightmare monsters, killers, and cursed horrors await behind the doors...

👁️‍🗨️ Escape from killer clowns, haunted dolls, SCP creatures, a cursed animatronic bear, and a deadly red light green light doll!
Inspired by Insane Elevator, but way more terrifying.

WHATS NEW?✨

🏃 This is a scary elevator survival game where fear, panic, and quick thinking are your only hope...

🎁 Join the group for daily free rewards!
🔔 Follow the game to be the first to see new floors, monsters, and weekly updates.
👻 New horrors added soon. Stay alive!
